newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Bonds market takes trade at Tunis bourse up.
newsitem.headline: Bonds market takes trade at Tunis bourse up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly down by 0.02 percent in higher trade boosted by the bonds market, a bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 496.76 from 496.86 on Monday.
Total volume was 5.14 million dinars against 2.78 million dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the bonds market was 4.36 million dinars.
Chemical firm ICF gained 1.42 dinars to 49.04 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia rose 0.2 dinar to 44.4. Palm Beach Hotels was up 0.1 dinar to 10.6.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel fell 0.2 dinar to 14.6 dinars.
BTEI bank was down 0.18 dinar to 22.82 dinars.
